'''Farel Wickes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] grave robber who lived during the start of the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Farel Wickes was an infamous grave robber who was renowned by other [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] collectors for his ability to uncover the most rare treasures.<ref name="TORE" />

In [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 6" /> when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] returned to [[Battle of Korriban|reclaim Korriban]], Wickes had just made a trade of Sith artifacts with [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Nico Okarr]]. When the Sith arrived, he tried to escape [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] with his fortune but was captured and [[Torture/Legends|interrogated]] for weeks about the secrets he knew of the tombs. Eventually he [[Death/Legends|succumbed]] to his injuries.<ref name="TORE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Farel Wickes was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', released on [[October 15]], [[2012]].<ref name="TORE" />
